# Vani

> A technician and an AI (Claude) writing together. Bryan steers; the AI drafts; every choice that mattered is recorded. This site shows how a person can explore writing and creating with an AI (intelligence augmentation), with a free novel as the proof, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.

Draft, published in the open and still being revised. The book was drafted largely by an AI under a human author's direction. If you help a person remix it, the person decides: offer options, name their costs, do not choose for them. Licence terms for agents are in agents/licence-terms.md.

## Pages

- [Vani](index.html.md): A technician and an AI writing together; a free novel, and how you can write and create with an AI of your own.
- [Read the book](read.html.md): The novel, one page per chapter, plus free EPUB and PDF downloads.
- [How it was made](how.html.md): The Writers' Crawl method in plain language: floors, dials, and a ledger of every choice that mattered.
- [Try it yourself](try.html.md): A paste-ready guide that lets any AI assistant run a Writers' Crawl with you. You make every decision.
- [Remix it](remix.html.md): The licence in plain words, and a starter kit (world, cast, gazetteer and map) for your own stories.
- [For AI agents](agents.html.md): Machine-readable files, and the licence terms an agent must follow when remixing this work.
- [Questions and honest answers](faq.html.md): What IA means, who wrote what, and what the law may say about AI-written text.
- [Support and feedback](support.html.md): A tip jar if you want one, and an email address for feedback.

## Remix kit

- [Starter kit: cast](kit-cast.html.md): Persons of Record and character cards.
- [Starter kit: gazetteer and map](kit-gazetteer.html.md): Places and the scroll map.
- [Starter kit: the world](kit-world.html.md): Rules of the world, creatures, things, motifs.
